Internal function

Source: R/coord.check.R
coord.check.Rd

Coordinates check

coord.check(
  XY,
  listing = TRUE,
  proj_type = NULL,
  listing_by_valid = FALSE,
  cell_size = NULL,
  check_eoo = TRUE
)

Arguments

XY

data.frame, of at least two columns (coordinates), third is taxa

listing

logical, whether the dataset should be splitted in a list by taxa

proj_type

crs

listing_by_valid

logical

cell_size

numeric value

check_eoo

logical

Value

a list with verified dataset and added columns

Examples


dataset <- coord.check(XY = dummy_dist())
dataset$list_data
